name: Haircut
overview: Scripture presents haircuts as a significant symbol of holiness and separation to God, particularly in the context of the Nazarite vow where the hair is not to be cut as a mark of dedication (Numbers 6:5; Judges 13:5). The commands in Leviticus prohibit certain hair and beard cuttings, emphasizing the importance of honoring God's standards in personal appearance (Leviticus 19:27; 21:5). The story of Samson illustrates the spiritual consequences tied to hair, where the loss of his hair led to the loss of his God-given strength, underscoring the connection between physical appearance and covenant faithfulness (Judges 16:17, 19).
